寄り道の研究で片目の見えないラクダに出会った――The Art of Related Detours

I prefer a related detour to jumping straight into a task. その感覚をcuriosity、探索と活用、情報探索、科学史から検討するEnglish Mix。An unexpected one-eyed camel, 17.9 million papers, and a 1945 imagined machine lead to one question: how do we find our way back?
